{{# Signature fieldtype (App\Fieldtypes\Signature). Captures a drawn signature on a via signature_pad, lazy-loaded by the Alpine `signatureField` component (resources/js/signature-field.js — NOT Vue), writing the base64 PNG data URL into the hidden input, matching what Signature::process() stores. Accessibility fallback (UAMS-Web/uams-statamic-archive#674): pointer-free users switch to "type" mode and submit a typed full name + attestation checkbox; the hidden input then carries the typed name (a plain string Signature::process() also accepts). A hidden input cannot carry HTML5 `required`, so an empty required signature is caught server-side by the form's `required` rule (Signature::process() nulls empties). #}}
{{# Draw mode — canvas capture (default). #}}
{{# Type mode — accessible non-canvas fallback. Hidden until Alpine toggles it (inline style avoids a pre-init flash without depending on an x-cloak rule). #}}
{{# The submitted value: a base64 PNG data URL (drawn) or the attested typed name. Bound to Alpine `value`; App\Fieldtypes\Signature::process() nulls an empty submission. #}}
